evaluation_metadata.rubric_scale: 0 to 3 ordinal scale; Technical defects separated
evaluation_metadata.notes: Original grades recorded independently without rater cross-communication. Disagreements resolved per documented adjudication protocol.

c1_01_cloud_lead.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous exceptional fit: all 4 skills matched, deep microservices and database achievements, strong fintech background.

c1_02_python_dev.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous good fit: solid Python/FastAPI/Postgres and banking experience; missing Docker/K8s.

c1_03_devops_infra.pdf.adjudication_notes: Minor discrepancy (|A-B|=1): Reviewer A favored deep infrastructure and containerization; Reviewer B noted missing FastAPI. Adjudicated consensus: 2.5 (strong partial fit).

c1_04_junior_backend.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous marginal fit: junior background (1.5 yrs), missing Docker/PostgreSQL, no preferred domain exposure.

c1_05_skill_noise.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous partial fit: core technical skills present (Python, FastAPI, Docker) despite irrelevant noise skills.

c1_06_tools_in_exp_only.pdf.adjudication_notes: Minor discrepancy (|A-B|=1): Reviewer A credited professional container work; Reviewer B penalized absence of project portfolio. Adjudicated consensus: 1.5.

c1_07_overlapping_dates.pdf.adjudication_notes: Critical verification: Both reviewers graded criteria relevance as 3 (exceptional technical alignment), while independently marking duration_satisfied=False due to 2.0 unique calendar years vs. 3.0 required.

c1_08_multi_unrelated_exp.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous: non-technical prior service jobs do not dilute verified 3 years of fintech development capability.

c1_09_unrelated_designer.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous clean zero: graphic design background with zero relevance to backend cloud infrastructure.

c1_10_defect_timeout.pdf.adjudication_notes: Technical failure: LLM extraction timeout. Both reviewers flagged as technical defect, explicitly excluded from Grade 0.

c2_01_nlp_researcher.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous exceptional fit: PhD NLP background, LLM fine-tuning, FAISS vector search, all skills matched.

c2_02_ml_engineer.pdf.adjudication_notes: Minor discrepancy (|A-B|=1): Reviewer A highlighted practical inference deployment (Ollama); Reviewer B noted missing theoretical NLP depth. Adjudicated consensus: 2.5.

c2_03_data_scientist.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous good fit: solid classical NLP and text classification, but lacks PyTorch/transformer deep learning experience.

c2_04_junior_ml.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous marginal fit: computer vision intern background, lacks NLP and vector search, 1.0 yr experience vs. 2.0 min.

c2_05_skill_noise.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous: core PyTorch/NLP skills verified despite presence of extraneous finance and accounting skills.

c2_06_tools_in_exp_only.pdf.adjudication_notes: Minor discrepancy (|A-B|=1): Reviewer A gave credit for enterprise FAISS/HuggingFace usage; Reviewer B penalized lack of demonstrable projects. Adjudicated consensus: 1.5.

c2_07_overlapping_dates.pdf.adjudication_notes: Critical verification: Both reviewers graded criteria relevance as 3 (exceptional deep learning research), with duration_satisfied=False due to 1.0 unique calendar year vs. 2.0 min required.

c2_08_multi_unrelated_exp.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous: culinary experience does not dilute 2.5 years of text embeddings research.

c2_09_unrelated_accountant.pdf.adjudication_notes: Unanimous clean zero: CPA corporate auditor with zero machine learning or computer science background.

c2_10_defect_retrieval.pdf.adjudication_notes: Technical failure: vector retrieval dimension mismatch. Excluded from relevance grading; flagged as technical defect.
